messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — after the cert rotation this morning I'm seeing mTLS handshake failures from services in eu-west-1 to model-serving: `verify return:21`, `sslv3 alert certificate unknown`. Affects only a subset of nodes. :eyes:
cert-rotation-bot: rotated intermediate CA cert for prod-cluster-eu at 2025-09-12T11:07:03Z (rotation-id: r-09f3a).
Lee Park: saw same. TL;DR some envoy frontends fail, others fine. Failures mostly from services behind NLBs.
Jordan (sre): Can you paste `openssl s_client` output for a failing host? Check if fullchain is served.
Maya Chen: here's sample output from failing pod -> cluster-ip:443:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect model-svc.eu-west-1.internal:443 -showcerts -servername model-svc
CONNECTED(00000003)
140735...: verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
140735...: verify return:1
...certificate chain
depth=2 C = US, O = Redwood, CN = Redwood Root CA
depth=1 C = US, O = Redwood, CN = Redwood Intermediate CA
depth=0 CN = model-svc
verify return:1
140735...: SSL routines:tls_process_server_certificate:certificate verify failed
```
Maya Chen: note that `-showcerts` shows only leaf + root, intermediate missing.
Tamara Singh: That explains `verify return:21` — clients can't build chain. Did the LB/ingress drop intermediate in the chain?
Lee Park: Looking at the pod logs for cert-rotator, rotation succeeded but S3 upload for fullchain object returned 200 without intermediate? Weird. Also saw KMS decrypt warnings earlier.
Jordan (sre): I pulled tcpdump from one of the failing nodes. The server sent 2 certs, not 3. Likely Envoy config `tls_certificate` route has `certificate_chain` pointing to the leaf only.
Tamara Singh: KMS angle — rotation process decrypts private key via KMS. If rotation writes incomplete bundle due to a permissions error during assemble step, that could explain it. Check CloudTrail for `kms:Decrypt` and the cert-rotator role.
Lee Park: CloudTrail shows `kms:Decrypt` allowed for rotation role, but there are intermittent `iam:PassRole` denies for service-account used by the deploy job at 11:04:57Z. Might have aborted the post-rotation step that concatenates intermediates.
Maya Chen: Audit logs from the cert service show `post-rotation: assemble_fullchain` timed out at 11:06:02. Payload incomplete written to S3.
cert-rotation-bot: rollback available. Use `rotate --rollback r-09f3a` to revert to previous rotation.
Tamara Singh: For mitigation we should: 1) roll back to previous rotation to restore connectivity 2) block further automated rotations until we fix IAM/KMS RBAC 3) update runbook to validate `fullchain` on each node post-rotation (simple `openssl s_client -showcerts`) 4) add CloudTrail alert for `s3:PutObject` where content-length < expected or where object missing intermediate.
Jordan (sre): Agreed. I'll open a P1 incident channel and run rollback. Also will patch envoy to have a health check that fails on missing intermediate (fast fail) so can detect earlier.
Lee Park: Notes for permanent fix: - ensure cert-rotator service-account has `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:DescribeKey`, `iam:PassRole` (for deploy job) - cert assemble step must validate chain order (leaf -> intermediate(s) -> root) and reject partial bundles - LB / NLB listeners must serve `fullchain` (some AWS NLB TLS proxies expect fullchain).
Tamara Singh: TLS hardening items while we're here: - enforce min TLS v1.3 on internal mTLS if clients support it - enable OCSP stapling on envoy for public endpoints - prefer AEAD ciphers (TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256) and disable RSA key exchange ciphers - enable TLS session resumption via tickets for performance.
Maya Chen: Also we hit a subtle cross-region behavior: eu-west-1 had an older image of the cert-rotator (no intermediate concatenation fix). Staging/na regions already had the new image. Need canary across regions.
Jordan (sre): Incident actions taken: rolled back rotation r-09f3a at 11:19 UTC -> connectivity restored in ~40s. Opened issue INF-2043 to track root cause.
Lee Park: I'll follow up with a patch to the rotation job to assert `openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt /etc/ssl/certs/fullchain.pem` before S3 upload. If verification fails, job should abort and alert.
Tamara Singh: For audit/compliance: add an append-only audit log entry for rotation events (rotation-id, operator, iam role used, KMS key-id, target clusters, fullchain checksum). Store in read-only retention bucket. Also add CloudWatch metric for `cert_fullchain_verification_failed`.
Maya Chen: Good. Also reminder: update RBAC — limit the rotation permission to an org-admin group, and add time-limited ephemeral tokens for humans to approve rotations (prevent silent automated failures).
Jordan (sre): Final note — postmortem should include timeline, affected services, detection gap (no fast fail), and code fix (assembly + IAM). I'll draft and ping for review. :lock: :white_check_mark:
cert-rotation-bot: incident INF-2043 created, severity P1, channel #incident-INF-2043
deploy-bot: canary rollback executed in eu-west-1 (all nodes back to v2025.09.10-3).
Maya Chen: Thanks team. Follow-ups: Lee -> rotation job patch, Tamara -> RBAC/audit changes, Jordan -> postmortem + healthcheck. I'll compile owner list and timeline.
Jordan (sre): 👍 will attach logs and `openssl` outputs to the incident thread.
